identify: Which part of the plant makes food using sunlight? (Leaf vs Root vs Stem)

sort: Drag plant parts to above ground or under ground (Above: stem, leaf, flower, fruit | Under: root)
extraInstructions: IMPORTANT: Do NOT use speechManager.speak() anywhere in the game. Only use audioManager.play() for sound effects. Valid sound effects: pickup, drop-correct, drop-wrong, tap, success, error, celebration, hint. Teach: (1) Plant types — trees (tall, thick trunk), shrubs (short, thin woody stems), herbs (small, soft stems). (2) Plant parts — root (under soil, holds plant, drinks water), stem (stands up, carries water), leaf (makes food), flower (colourful, makes seeds), fruit (holds seeds). Misconceptions: "small plant = herb, big plant = tree" (check stem too - rose is small but woody = shrub), "root is not a part" (root IS a part, hidden under soil), "all leaves are the same" (mango leaves are long, neem leaves are small). Default width=720, height=560. Use named export (export function PlantsGame), NOT export default. Export interface PlantsGameProps with width?, height?, onComplete?: (score: number) => void.
